description: Generate a set of survey questions up-front for an agent stage, write them to {{outputFile}} in the task folder, and flag the stage as awaiting human input. The skill is used to replace iterative “grill-me” interactions with a single questionnaire.

outputFile.description: Name of the task-folder file that holds the question-me rounds. Defaults to SURVEY.md. Use distinct names (FEEDBACK.md, SECURITY_QUESTIONARY.md, INTENT_SURVEY.md, …) for multiple question stages. Canonical config key: outputFile (aliases: surveyFile, surveyFileName, fileName, targetFile, file).

minQuestions.description: Suggested minimum number of questions for the round (soft guidance only; 0 disables). Surfaced as {{minQuestions}} in the skill body.

context: Question rounds are written as append-only JSON blocks to {{outputFile}} in the current task's docs/tasks/<taskId>/ folder. Re-read that file before appending so earlier rounds and answers are preserved. Suggested minimum number of questions for this round: {{minQuestions}} (0 = no minimum). Use a distinct outputFile per question stage when a task needs multiple surveys (e.g. FEEDBACK.md, SECURITY_QUESTIONARY.md, INTENT_SURVEY.md).
